description: For each case, the sparse state an implementation of the timing kernel must return at each listed time, for a compiled document (compiled.schema.json) under a property space (a registered name from kinds.json, or inline). States are keyed by address (target:property); an address no clip has started is absent. Numbers agree within 1e-09 * max(1, |x|, |y|); everything else exactly. 'stage.node' cases use only the stage's easings and are also what runtime.js evaluates. Sample times include every clip and keyframe boundary and every midpoint between them.

cases.name: number-linear-and-log
cases.description: A linear number and a log-space number, with a dwell and a CSS ease-in-out.

cases.name: angle
cases.description: Shortest arc in degrees both ways across 0, radians, and wrap off.

cases.name: vector-and-quaternion
cases.description: A componentwise vector, and slerp including a target whose sign makes the dot product negative.

cases.name: color
cases.description: OKLab mixing with premultiplied alpha, in hex and array forms.

cases.name: color-srgb
cases.description: Componentwise sRGB mixing (the stage tint's and Manim's rule), hex and array forms.

cases.name: orbit
cases.description: Azimuth across 0, elevation lerp, log distance, target lerp, and an extra member that switches at the middle.

cases.name: discrete-and-undeclared
cases.description: Discrete fields switch on time under a timing whose progress crosses 0.5 three times; a declared and an overridden switch point; undeclared nested fields.

cases.name: timings
cases.description: cubic-bezier with overshoot, and steps with jump-end and jump-none.

cases.name: cuts-dwells-carry-forward
cases.description: Sequence defaults, a cut in the middle, dwells, carry-forward of omitted fields and back-fill of a field that appears late.

cases.name: per-field-timing
cases.description: A segment-wide timing with per-field overrides on a number and an angle.

cases.name: loop
cases.description: A seamless loop: the last keyframe equals the first.

cases.name: orbit-overshoot
cases.description: An orbit under an overshooting timing: elevation is clamped at the pole, azimuth and distance extrapolate.

cases.name: manim-rate-functions
cases.description: Manim rate functions as segment easings, including two that end where they began.

cases.name: an-numeric-easings
cases.description: Every stage easing and legacy-solver Béziers (one overshooting; three that reach the solver's slope guard and clamps) on a 0 to 10 ramp.

cases.name: an-large-magnitude-bezier
cases.description: Legacy-solver Béziers from 1e9 to 0: a ULP of easing is amplified by the span, so the solver's loop must match exactly.

cases.name: an-86-boundary
cases.description: A swap held on time: at the float just below the second key, (t - a) / span rounds to 1.0, and the first key still shows.

cases.name: an-swap-holds-under-any-easing
cases.description: A swap set holds its first key for the whole segment under every easing, overshooting Béziers included, and switches exactly at the second key.

cases.name: an-swap-shapes
cases.description: A three-key viseme track, duplicate-time keys (the later wins), a single-key channel, and booleans held like any swap value.

cases.name: an-held-end-value
cases.description: A clip placed at 0.5: at rest before, active during, its end value held after.

cases.name: an-swap-write-group
cases.description: viseme and viseme@happy share one write group: only the most recently written shows.

cases.name: an-alias-write-group
cases.description: rotation_rad writes rotation: the later write of the two shows.

cases.name: an-speed
cases.description: A clip at double speed occupies half its duration.

cases.name: an-loop
cases.description: A looping clip whose window ends mid-cycle holds the value at the window's end.

cases.name: an-ping-pong
cases.description: A ping-pong clip bounces over its duration.

cases.name: an-step-swap-clip
cases.description: A step swap clip placed at 1.0.

cases.name: an-playing-beats-held
cases.description: A clip still playing on an earlier track beats one that ended on a later track.

cases.name: an-latest-end-and-tie
cases.description: The latest end holds; a tie goes to the later clip; another property is independent.

cases.name: an-cross-track-inclusive-end
cases.description: A clip is active on [start, end] inclusive: at a shared instant the later track wins, whether its clip starts or ends there.
